description: Realtime ephemeral UX via Supabase broadcast channels (NO DB writes, NO new tables): (a) emoji reactions panel locked bottom-center in both lobby and play, with a balloon-rise+grow+fade overlay animation (~1.5-2.5s) that must NOT steal focus or cover the input (pointer-events:none overlay) and a per-emoji synthetic SFX; (b) a big/prominent start-game sound played on ALL clients when the room transitions to playing; (c) an informational-only ready-check (broadcast, no DB): host triggers a confirm pop-up on every player's screen, each player answers ready(green)/not-ready(red), pop-up auto-closes after 7s, non-responders count as not ready, and each player's lobby chip is tinted green(ready)/red(not ready) locally; the Start button is NOT gated by the result. Builds on FEAT-002 (play layout, PlayerChip) and should be done last.
steps: src/lib/sound.ts: add three per-emoji SFX exports using the existing tone() helper (keep style/volumes consistent): e.g. sfxEmojiTease (playful descending), sfxEmojiLaugh (bright bouncy triad), sfxEmojiAngry (harsh sawtooth cluster). Also add a big sfxGameStart fanfare/whoosh (louder/longer than sfxWin, a few tones chained with delays). Do not change existing exports.

Create a reusable realtime reactions module, e.g. src/lib/useRoomReactions.ts (mirror usePresence structure). It opens a Supabase broadcast channel named `reactions:CODE` (config broadcast self:true so the sender also sees it), exposes `sendReaction(emoji)` which broadcasts { emoji } , and invokes an onReaction callback for incoming events. Use channel.send({ type: 'broadcast', event: 'emoji', payload }). Clean up the channel on unmount.

Create a reactions overlay + panel component, e.g. src/components/ReactionLayer.tsx. The bottom-locked panel: `fixed bottom-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2` with 3 buttons showing the three emojis (tease=\uD83D\uDE1C, laugh=\uD83D\uDE02, angry=\uD83D\uDE21) styled with existing tokens (rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-soft). The animation overlay: a `fixed inset-0 z-40 pointer-events-none` layer that renders transient emoji elements rising upward while scaling up and fading out over ~2s, then removed from state. Add the balloon keyframes to the global stylesheet (src/app/globals.css) following existing keyframe patterns (e.g. animate-pop-in); name it e.g. `emoji-rise`. Clicking a panel button calls sendReaction(emoji) AND plays the matching SFX; incoming reactions (via the hook) spawn an animated element and play the SFX. Ensure pointer-events:none on the animation layer so it never blocks the input field.

Wire ReactionLayer + useRoomReactions into src/app/room/[code]/page.tsx (lobby) and src/app/room/[code]/play/page.tsx (play). Place the panel so it does not overlap critical controls (bottom-center, above safe area). On play, confirm the animation overlay sits above content but pointer-events:none so the WordInput keeps focus.

Start-game sound: detect the room status transition to 'playing' on ALL clients and play sfxGameStart. Implement by tracking the previous room.status in a ref on the lobby page (src/app/room/[code]/page.tsx) — when it flips from 'lobby' to 'playing', call sfxGameStart() before/at the router.push to play. Because non-host players also observe the status change via useRoomRealtime, this fires on every client. (Alternatively broadcast a 'start' event on the reactions/room channel; prefer the status-transition approach for reliability. Pick the status-transition approach.) Ensure unlockAudio() has been called (the home/lobby interaction already unlocks).

Ready-check (informational, broadcast only). Add to the lobby page a host-only checklist icon button (near the Start button) that broadcasts a 'readycheck:open' event on the `reactions:CODE` channel (or a dedicated `ready:CODE` channel — pick one channel and document it). On every client, receiving 'readycheck:open' shows a pop-up (reuse the modal styling pattern: fixed inset-0 z-50 flex center, white rounded-3xl card, animate-pop-in) with a green check (ready) and red cross (not ready) button; it auto-closes after 7s (setTimeout). When a player answers (or on nothing within 7s => not ready), broadcast a 'readycheck:answer' event { playerId, ready }. Every client maintains a local map playerId->ready and tints each PlayerChip green (ready) or red (not ready/no response). Implement the tint by adding optional props to PlayerChip, e.g. `readyState?: 'ready' | 'notready'` that applies a green/red ring or background using existing sage/coral tokens; default (undefined) renders normally. The Start button MUST remain enabled regardless of ready states.
Confirm the ready-check and emoji features write nothing to the database (broadcast only) and create no new tables or columns.
acceptance_criteria: A bottom-center 3-emoji panel appears in both lobby and play; clicking broadcasts to all room clients and shows a rising/growing/fading balloon (~1.5-2.5s) on every screen.
The animation overlay uses pointer-events:none and does not cover or steal focus from the input field.
Each emoji plays a distinct synthetic SFX from sound.ts on appearance.
A big sfxGameStart sound plays on all clients (host and players) when the room becomes 'playing'.

Host has a checklist button that pops a ready/not-ready confirm on every player's screen; it auto-closes after 7s; non-responders are treated as not ready; lobby chips tint green/red accordingly; Start is never disabled by ready state.
No new DB tables/columns and no DB writes for emoji or ready-check (broadcast channels only).
`npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` exits 0 and `npx next build` exits 0.
verification: From d:\ADO\KiroAI\game-apps run `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json *> tsc.log`; read tsc.log, confirm empty + $LASTEXITCODE 0.
From d:\ADO\KiroAI\game-apps run `npx next build *> build.log`; read build.log, confirm 'Compiled successfully' + $LASTEXITCODE 0.

Confirm by reading code that reactions/ready-check use supabase channel .send broadcast (not postgres_changes) and no supabase.from(...).insert/update is introduced for these. Delete tsc.log and build.log after.
findings:
Implemented realtime ephemeral UX, broadcast-only (no DB writes, no new tables/columns).

- src/lib/sound.ts: added sfxEmojiTease (playful descending triangle), sfxEmojiLaugh (bright bouncy sine triad), sfxEmojiAngry (harsh descending sawtooth cluster), and a big sfxGameStart fanfare (5 chained triangle tones G-C-E-G-C' with a thin sawtooth whoosh layer, louder/longer than sfxWin). Existing exports untouched.
- src/lib/useRoomReactions.ts (new): mirrors usePresence; opens one Supabase broadcast channel `reactions:CODE` with config broadcast self:true. Exposes sendReaction(emoji), openReadyCheck(), answerReadyCheck(playerId, ready). Listens for broadcast events 'emoji', 'readycheck:open', 'readycheck:answer' via handler refs (no re-subscribe per render). Cleans up channel on unmount. No supabase.from(...) usage.
- src/app/globals.css: added `emoji-rise` keyframe (balloon rise + scale up 0.6->2.6 + fade over 2s) before the reduced-motion block.
- src/components/ReactionLayer.tsx (new): bottom-center locked panel (fixed bottom-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2, rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-soft) with 3 emoji buttons (tease=\uD83D\uDE1C, laugh=\uD83D\uDE02, angry=\uD83D\uDE21). Animation overlay is `fixed inset-0 z-40 pointer-events-none` so it never covers/steals focus from the input. Clicking broadcasts via sendReaction; incoming reactions (self included) spawn a rising element + play matching SFX; elements removed from state after ~2.1s. Optional onReady/onReadyOpen/onReadyAnswer props let the lobby reuse the single channel for ready-check.
- play page (src/app/room/[code]/play/page.tsx): wired <ReactionLayer roomCode={code} />, added pb-28 so the panel clears the player list. WordInput keeps focus (overlay is pointer-events:none).
- lobby page (src/app/room/[code]/page.tsx): wired ReactionLayer (shares reactions:CODE channel, provides API via onReady ref). Start-game sound via status-transition: prevStatusRef tracks room.status; when it flips lobby->playing, sfxGameStart() fires on ALL clients (every client observes the transition via useRoomRealtime) before router.push to /play. Added pointerdown unlockAudio listener. Host-only checklist button (✅) placed beside Start; it broadcasts 'readycheck:open'. On receipt every client shows an animate-pop-in modal (fixed inset-0 z-50) with Siap(green)/Belum(red); auto-closes after 7s (READY_CHECK_MS) and non-responders broadcast ready:false. Each client keeps a local readyMap and tints PlayerChip via new readyState prop. Start button is NOT gated by ready state.
- src/components/PlayerChip.tsx: added optional readyState?: 'ready'|'notready' prop -> sage-bg/ring (ready) or coral-bg/ring (not ready); undefined renders normally.

Ready-check channel decision: reuses the single `reactions:CODE` broadcast channel (events readycheck:open / readycheck:answer) rather than a separate ready:CODE channel, to avoid opening two channels on the lobby page.

No DB writes or schema changes were introduced for emoji or ready-check (broadcast .send only; verified by grep that no supabase.from insert/update was added).
